slides.title: Clashes in the disputed town
slides.body: Residents told Wazema federal troops fought TPLF forces in Badme last week, with Eritrean troops also reportedly involved.

slides.title: Fresh fighting near Rama
slides.body: Residents say federal forces clashed on Monday with a reported joint armed force in Rama and Gemahalo. Wazema could not verify the force's make-up.

slides.title: public employees in Tigray
slides.body: Federal adviser Getachew Reda's figure. Salary arrears are due to start Nov 11, only for staff who reported to work.
